matched_work.interpretation: Latest accepted state at or below each common candidate budget; never credit a future update. Candidate count is the declared work proxy, not equal CPU work.

interpretation: The short-run multistatic geometric benefit persists across the longer run and all compared accepted-event candidate budgets; both runs stop before declared caps because no decreasing admissible neural step is found.

Multistatic improves bulk position/size and symmetric error but does not recover the target five lobes: m5 amplitude collapses and wrong radial modes grow; its modest phase-aware m5 error improvement reverses after retrospective best state19.

Paired loses polar single-valuedness about its polygon area centroid from state25; final polar amplitudes/phases must remain unavailable. Its aggregate RMS and evaluation also deteriorate slightly after retrospective minima.
Field-gradient spread grows substantially in both arms, particularly paired, while accepted conversion approaches the unchanged0.2mm limit. These are measurements, not a demonstrated unique cause.

Accepted normal-motion scores cover all transitions; selected finite proposal-motion scores are incomplete at late states due geometry failures. Local normal-mode scores cannot substitute for actual global shape metrics.
No automatic promotion to higher frequency, neural GN, changed optimizer, or relaxed conversion limits follows from these measurements.
